subject: Post-remediation penetration reinspection plan and scheduling
messages:
From: Omar Sayeed <omar.sayeed@securetest.co>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LumenVault SecOps <security@lumenvault.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PT closure — request for reinspection window

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the remediation notes you sent earlier — our initial review looks promising. Before we issue a formal closure letter we need to perform a targeted reinspection focused on the three CVEs you remediated (CVE-2027-0812, CVE-2027-0816, and the session-fix race condition).

Proposed scope for the reinspection:
- Verify applied patches for the vulnerable service (service-api) and the session manager.
- Smoke test for regression in authentication flows.
- Confirm no new privileged file exposures from the k8s config changes.

We can run a credentialed reinspection the week of Jun 28. Typical slot is 3 hours (nonblocking) with a short follow-up scan the next day. Please confirm:
1) Which environment you'd like us to test (staging vs preprod).
2) A point-of-contact with SSH/API creds and expected maintenance windows.

Attach: initial findings summary (pdf).

Thanks,
Omar
Senior Consultant, SecureTest Co.

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Omar Sayeed <omar.sayeed@securetest.co>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, LumenVault SecOps <security@lumenvault.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PT closure — request for reinspection window

Hi Omar — thanks for the quick read. We can accommodate the credentialed reinspection and prefer preprod for the run (mirrors prod traffic and includes the fixed k8s manifests).

Quick answers:
- Environment: preprod (cluster: preprod-us-west-2).
- POC for run: Aditya Rao (aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com) — he'll provide temporary service account creds and will be online for the entire test window.
- Maintenance windows: none scheduled; we request testing between 09:00-16:00 PT to align with our on-call.

I've attached the remediation summary and an evidence index CSV that maps commits/PRs to each finding. Expect a follow-up from Aditya with the creds by EOD.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales Operations (SaaS Accounts) — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: PT closure — request for reinspection window

Omar — attaching the temporary service account (expires in 72h) and a small patch diff for the kube manifests. Credentials: service-test-preprod (token provided in separate secure channel). We will be available Jun 29 10:00-13:00 PT for the primary window. Secondary follow-up: Jun 30 09:00-10:00 PT.

Notes for the test team:
- Authentication tests: use the staging SSO test client (client-id: rv-test-client).
- No load testing; please keep requests under 30 RPS to avoid noisy neighbors.
- If you find regressions, file issues with the tag "pt-retest-2027" and notify Neha immediately.

Attachments: retest-evidence-index.csv, k8s-config-diff.patch

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PT closure — request for reinspection window

Thanks for the details and the creds. We confirm the primary window: Jun 29 10:00-13:00 PT (preprod).

A couple of clarifications before we start:
- We will perform credentialed checks against the session manager; please confirm that debug logging is disabled in preprod to avoid sensitive data leakage.
- For the k8s manifest diff, did you also rotate the service account tokens after applying the patch? We need to validate token rotation as part of the closure.
- Please confirm whether the backup snapshot from Jun 14 (pre-remediation) is retained offline for rollback testing — we will not touch backups but may request hashes for comparison.

Deliverables after reinspection:
1) Short closure memo (within 48h) covering verified fixes and any residual risk.
2) Delta attestation addendum (if applicable) to append to the prior pen-test report.
3) Final closure letter once all items are confirmed.

Once we complete the run we'll send a calendar invite and a one-hour readout on Jun 30.

—Omar
SecureTest Co.
